raw_segments.text: Poor soul, Camilla presently went on. I knew they had all been looking at me in the meantime
Would anyone believe that when Tom's wife died he actually could not be induced to see the importance of the children's having the deepest
Of trimmings to their mourning good Lord says he Camilla
What can it signify so long as the poor bereaved little things are in black so like Matthew the idea?
